Phase M6.P2, under the interface epic #700 (retitled `E700/T21` and re-parented at dispatch, `milestone-phase-naming.md`; T2 #649 and T18 #665 are its accepted siblings, T20 #667 its briefed one; the OS side of `system.cfg` is T1 #648's). Proposed by the survey (#641); the order is D-WORKFLOW-188 (the fourth version, 2026-10-23). Run under the per-slice procedure of `docs/reviews/plan-for-the-plan.md` § 6b, from the brief the planner writes before dispatch (§ 7).

## Scope

- **Area:** interface; **kind:** read; **lens:** security, state preservation (the preliminary review)
- **Why here:** `Settings`, `SystemConf` and `AtomicFileUtil` write `es_settings.cfg`, `system.cfg` and the last-good copies; `HttpReq` is the network client; `ApiSystem` assembles the shell commands every page runs, from player-entered strings (Wi-Fi, accounts); `GuiWifi` and `ScreenScraper` carry credentials. All are on the order's security or state lists, so they are cut out of their Independent slices into one Extended read (claude, gemini, gpt)
- **Paths:** areas `interface`; globs `es:es-app/src/ApiSystem.*`, `es:es-app/src/guis/GuiWifi.*`, `es:es-app/src/scrapers/ScreenScraper.*`, `es:es-core/src/{Settings,SystemConf,HttpReq}.*`, `es:es-core/src/utils/AtomicFileUtil.*`. 14 paths, 9,249 lines; 9,249 lines read, 9,249 of them fork-own (inventory at `eb4763e3cc`). The exact list is `tools/renovation-inventory --order`'s membership of `es-state-and-bridge`.
- **Provenance tiers:** fork-own 14
- **Read before:** none (the renovation gates no release, D-WORKFLOW-187)
- **Review depth:** Extended -- security and state preservation (plan § 6c)
- **Interacting subsystems (read-only context):** the OS scripts `ApiSystem` calls (`os-launch-control-state`, `os-system-services`, `cloud-setup-content`); `setsettings.sh` and `get_setting`, the other end of `system.cfg`; `backuptool`'s settings archives (`cloud-setup-content`); the last-good tests (`tooling-last-good-test`); `es-code-traps.md` (the pooled connection)

One guest window, one boot of M6's `069fc2704421` copy started at 640x480: the identity, the modes of both stores, their copies, the cookie jar and the NetworkManager keyfile as written after a join driven by `tools/cloud-input-test`'s fake networks, the recovery ladder on the image for both stores with the player's frame, the Wi-Fi key on argv as a masked count of processes, the `7z` positive on a scratch library's ROM named with a command substitution, the #1154 positive (`screenscraper.fr` pointed by the guest's hosts file at a host-run TLS endpoint with a self-signed certificate; the pin's scrape reaches it), and one live sign-in with the QA ScreenScraper account last if the bound allows (D-QA-016; never the owner's, D-QA-015; `CANNOT in this window` otherwise).
